date: "2026-06-30"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
codes <- read_csv(here::here("processed_data", "error_codes_7810.csv"))
```

```{r}
recent <- codes %>%
  filter(TIMESTAMP > as_date(Sys.Date()) - days(10))

p <- recent %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = TIMESTAMP, y = Diag_7810))+
  geom_point()

p <- recent %>%
  filter(as_date(TIMESTAMP) == as_date("2026-06-22"),
         hour(TIMESTAMP) %in% 7:8) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = TIMESTAMP, y = Diag_7810, color = as.factor(Chamber)))+
  geom_point()

plotly::ggplotly(p)
```
